readings.Aries: Something is beginning. You felt it before you understood it. Don't wait for the signal — you are the signal. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Taurus: The softness in you is not weakness. It is precisely what the situation needs. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Gemini: Your attention is the most valuable thing you have. Right now, it's scattered. Collect it. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Cancer: The thing you're waiting for permission to need — you have it. You always have. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Leo: You radiate energy that others orient toward. Use this for good today — including your own good. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Virgo: The flaw you keep returning to is not the problem. The returning is the problem. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Libra: Someone has been telling you what you want to hear. You already know this. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Scorpio: Your instinct for what people really mean is almost always correct. It's protecting you today. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Sagittarius: There is a commitment you made lightly that another person is holding seriously. Honour it. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Capricorn: There is a shortcut available. You won't take it on principle. Make sure the principle is worth it. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Aquarius: The independence you protect is real and necessary. Today it is being used defensively rather than freely. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Pisces: The feeling that's been following you is real. It belongs to you, not to the situation it attached to. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
